title: Metabolite Extraction Using Modified Bligh and Dyer Method and Untargeted LC-MS
author: Mun Fai Loke
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.u4ceysw

steps.title: Pulverize Tissue
steps.instruction: Pulverize the tissue into a fine powder using liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Initial Solvent Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract metabolites using chloroform and methanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 ml of chloroform and 200 ml of methanol to the fine powder.
Resuspend the mixture by vigorous vortexing.
Store the mixture at room temperature for 30 min.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the mixture into biphasic solutions.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 ml of chloroform and 100 ml of water to the mixture and mix.
Centrifuge the tube at 12,000 xg for 10 min.
Separate the biphasic solutions into two separate tubes, ensuring the protein precipitate at the interface is not disturbed.

steps.title: Sample Concentration and Reconstitution
steps.instruction: Concentrate the samples and reconstitute them for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Vacuum concentrate samples to dryness in a Refrigerated CentriVap concentrator (Labconco, USA) at 4 °C.
Reconstitute samples with 20 ml of mobile phase (95% water:5% ACN).
Vortex and centrifuge at 12,000 xg for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: LC-MS System Configuration
steps.instruction: Set up the Agilent 1260 Infinity-6540 UHD Q-TOF LC/MS system with Dual Agilent Jet Stream ESI source.

substeps.instruction: Install a Zorbax Eclipse plus C-18 RRHT 2.1x 100mm 1.8 mm column.
Set the injection volume to 3 ml of sample.
Set the flow rate to 0.45 mL/min.
Prepare Mobile phase A (0.1% formic acid in Milli-Q water) and Mobile phase B (0.1% formic acid in acetonitrile).
Configure the linear gradient program: t=0 min (5% B); t=2 min (5% B); t=15 min (98% B); t=18 min (98% B); t=20 min (5% B); t=25 min (5% B).

steps.title: Mass Spectrometry Parameter Setup
steps.instruction: Configure the MS source and ionization settings.

substeps.instruction: Set gas temperature to 300 °C and drying gas flow to 8 L/min.
Set sheath gas temperature to 350 °C and sheath gas flow to 11 L/min.
Set capillary voltage to 3500 V and nebulizer pressure to 35 psi.
Enable reference mass correction: for positive mode use 121.0509 m/z and 922.0098 m/z; for negative mode use 112.9855 and 1033.9881.

steps.title: Data Acquisition and Analysis
steps.instruction: Control the instrument and process the resulting data.

substeps.instruction: Use MassHunter Workstation software B.05.01 (Agilent Technologies, USA) for instrument control and data acquisition.
Analyze data using Mass Profiler Professional software version 12.6.1.
